serving.name: LMDeploy 0.18.0
serving.sm120_status: PyPI wheels built against CUDA 12.8 since v0.13.0 'including GeForce RTX 50 series' (README).
serving.verdict: Reject for this stack: supported-models table says TurboMind does not support the Qwen3.5 vision encoder, and PyTorch engine lists Qwen3-VL/Qwen3.5 with W4A16 = No (BF16 only, too big for 8 GB). Fine for InternVL3.5 W4A16.

recommendation: PRIMARY: Qwen3.5-4B (Apache-2.0, 2026-02) as cyankiwi/Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ-4bit on vLLM 0.32.0, non-thinking for per-step actions, thinking optional for replanning. Why: best small-model card scores (ERQA 54.0, EmbSpatial 81.3, MMMU 77.6); hybrid Gated-DeltaNet attention makes KV ~32 KiB/token (4.5x less than Qwen3-VL-4B), so n>1 self-consistency and long histories fit next to AI2-THOR; it is the base of 2026 embodied fine-tunes (RynnBrain1.1, Intern-Decision, Fara1.5, LocalNav), giving reviewers recognizable baselines. Caveat: independent ER evals (LightNav-0) put it slightly below Qwen3-VL-4B (60.8 vs 63.1 avg), and no EmbodiedBench number exists yet; measure both in week 1. BACKUP: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (cyankiwi/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-AWQ-4bit), same vLLM stack, standard attention (no GDN/mamba-cache edge cases), strong third-party spatial scores (HY-Embodied: ERQA 47.3, VSI 55.2). Report gains on both backbones (+Qwen3-VL-8B GGUF offline, simulator stopped) to show the method is backbone-agnostic. STACK: vLLM 0.32.0 in the existing conda env 'vlm' (python 3.12, torch 2.13.0+cu130), bound to 127.0.0.1 with --gpu-memory-utilization ~0.70, --max-model-len 8192, max_pixels 409600, VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0; use response_format json_schema for actions (fixes the JSON-decode failures seen in the 3B smoke run), logprobs for calibrated choice scores, n>1 for voting. Rejected: SGLang (manylinux_2_34 wheels, glibc 2.31 host); LMDeploy (no Qwen3.5 vision in TurboMind, BF16-only Qwen3-VL/3.5 in PyTorch engine); llama.cpp prebuilt (GLIBC 2.38) unless built from source; Ollama only for demos (no n>1, OpenAI endpoint drops logprobs). No separate text LLM: reuse the VLM text-only (Qwen3-VL-4B/8B text scores match or beat Qwen3-4B/8B).
install_commands: # 0) Env already exists (conda env 'vlm', built by robotics-agent/scripts/setup_env2.sh). To rebuild from scratch without sudo:
source ~/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda create -y -n vlm -c conda-forge python=3.12 pip && conda activate vlm

UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600 ~/miniforge3/bin/uv pip install --python "$(command -v python)" --index-url https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ 'vllm==0.32.0' openai pillow   # or https://mirror.nju.edu.cn/pypi/web/simple/
# 1) Models (ungated). ModelScope is ~10x faster than HF from this network; HF mirror fallback shown second.
# 2) Serve PRIMARY (stop any other vLLM server on the GPU first; loopback only, no auth -> add --api-key if ever exposed)

conda activate vlm && VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 vllm serve ~/models/Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ-4bit --served-model-name qwen3.5-4b --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.70 --max-model-len 8192 --max-num-seqs 8 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":2}' --mm-processor-kwargs '{"max_pixels":409600}' --reasoning-parser qwen3 --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":false}' --generation-config vllm
# If startup OOMs: lower --max-model-len to 6144 or add --enforce-eager; if mamba-cache errors appear, add --max-cudagraph-capture-size 8 (per vLLM Qwen3.5 recipe troubleshooting).

conda activate vlm && VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 vllm serve ~/models/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-AWQ-4bit --served-model-name qwen3-vl-4b --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.70 --max-model-len 8192 --max-num-seqs 8 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":2}' --mm-processor-kwargs '{"max_pixels":409600}' --generation-config vllm
# Optional for more KV room on Qwen3-VL: --kv-cache-dtype fp8 (flag exists in 0.32; not tested on sm_120).
